request  r-0000001  GET /v1/list?prefix=%2Fservices%2F&limit=500  502
error[ZC-E0812]: a certificate names another server than the one asked for
  cause  broker.botpike.com's certificate is for another server
  reqid  r-0000001
  fix    check that both sides use this cluster's CA (docs/peer.md)
